caption: find your sign. tag the one who is in tier one. jupiter stations retrograde at 27° leo tonight, 7:59 pm et (00:59 utc dec 13). neptune turns direct at 1.6° aries earlier today.

slides.headline: *jupiter* turns backwards in leo tonight. here is who feels it
*jupiter* seems to stop, then slide back
slides.body: earth is catching up to jupiter, so it looks like it reverses, and it stays that way into the new year. neptune turns direct in aries today.

rows.label: leo
rows.text: it's your sign. less show, more substance.

rows.label: aquarius
rows.text: partners slow down. ask, do not assume.

rows.label: scorpio
rows.text: career plans get a second draft.

rows.label: taurus
rows.text: home stuff resurfaces. deal with it kindly.

rows.label: aries
rows.text: an old flame looks warmer than it was.

rows.label: cancer
rows.text: count what you spend on others.

rows.label: virgo
rows.text: rest is not a reward. take it.

slides.headline: growth that slows down is still *growth*
slides.body: reread the promise before you make it bigger.
